items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of disability pension
items.quote: Wer mit diesem Bescheid nicht einverstanden ist, kann ihn mit dem Widerspruch anfechten; dafür steht ab der Bekanntgabe ein Monat zur Verfügung.
items.computation: Letter dated 29.09.2027 (Wednesday); assumed given to the post on the same day. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a written administrative act sent by post is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 3rd day after posting: 29.09.2027 + 3 days = 02.10.2027 (Saturday). This 3-day fiction is counted in calendar days and is not shifted for weekends, since it merely fixes the deemed delivery date, not a deadline's end. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of delivery (02.10.2027) is not counted, the period begins the next day (03.10.2027) and ends one month later on the day numerically corresponding to the delivery date, i.e. 02.11.2027. 02.11.2027 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen (01.11. Allerheiligen falls on the preceding Monday), so no further shift applies. Deadline: 02.11.2027.

warnings: The exact date the letter was handed to the postal service is assumed to be the same as the document date (29.09.2027); if it was posted later, the Widerspruch deadline shifts accordingly.
The letter mentions a separate forthcoming letter about Leistungen zur Teilhabe am Arbeitsleben, which contains no date and is not included as an item.
